title: Analista de Operações Logísticas - Rio de Janeiro, AMZL
description:
Description

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria.

Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes.

A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Analista de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de EDSP (External Delivery Service Providers), ou seja, as estações de entrega da AMZL operadas por parceiros. Essa pessoa irá atuar como Torre de Controle para essas operações operadas por parceiros, em turno 4x3. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, os Analistas de Operações Logísticas são todos em turno 4x3, separados entre equipe front e back.

Essa pessoa atuará na gestão de estações de entreda dos parceiros logísticos externos para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas.

Essa pessoa precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Parte de suas funções poderão ser realizadas virtualmente, como também auditoria /visitas aos parceiros logísticos in loco.

Nossa cultura inclusiva capacita os Amazonians a oferecer os melhores resultados para nossos clientes. Não celebramos apenas a diversidade de nossa força de trabalho, celebramos as diversas formas como trabalhamos. Se você quiser solicitar uma acomodação para a entrevista ou o processo de integração, avise seu recrutador e ele o conectará à nossa equipe de acomodação.

Key job responsibilities

  • Monitorar diariamente o funcionamento eficiente dos parceiros logísticos, sugerir e implantar melhorias;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais;

Basic Qualifications

  • Bacharelado em Engenharia, Administração, Operações ou áreas relacionadas.
  • MS Office, com nível avançado em Excel (vlookup, fórmulas avançadas, tabelas dinâmicas, macros).
  • Habilidade para multitarefas, gerenciando vários parceiros simultaneamente com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos flexíveis incluindo fins de semana e feriados.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens em 10% do tempo.
  • Inglês básico.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Inglês avançado.
  • Experiência em acompanhamento de processos, métricas e resolução de problemas.
  • Experiência em Logística, Transportes.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to help one of our enterprise clients unlock the value of their data for AI-driven use cases. The goal focus for this role is to "make the data AI-ready": well-structured, semantically rich, documented, and governed.

Your primary output is a clean, well-documented, and semantically meaningful data environment that downstream AI workloads can reason over reliably.

What You Will Do

Semantic Modeling

  • Design and build semantic layers that translate raw ERP tables into business-meaningful domains (finance, procurement, supply chain, etc.)
  • Define and enforce naming conventions, metric definitions, and business logic in a shared, governed layer
  • Work with Databricks semantic layer to expose curated datasets for AI and analytics consumption

Data Documentation and Context

  • Produce column-level documentation, data dictionaries, and business glossaries inside Unity Catalog
  • Establish lineage tracing from source system tables through to consumption-ready datasets
  • Collaborate with source systems stakeholders to capture domain knowledge and translate it into structured metadata

AI Readiness

  • Structure data to support LLM-based and ML workloads, including RAG pipelines and structured querying
  • Identify and address data quality gaps that would undermine AI model reliability
  • Define thematic data domains and organize datasets to give AI systems the right context and scope

Governance and Quality

  • Implement data quality rules and freshness monitors using Databricks tooling
  • Tag sensitive fields and support data access tier definitions within Unity Catalog
  • Own documentation standards and ensure the catalog remains accurate as data evolves

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data architecture, or a closely related discipline
  • Hands‑on Databricks expertise: Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, cluster configuration, and query optimization
  • Experience with semantic modeling tools, ideally dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud)
  • Strong SQL and a solid understanding of data modeling patterns (star schema, medallion architecture, etc.)
  • Ability to read and interpret unfamiliar data models quickly, including ERP-sourced data structures
  • Experience writing technical documentation that non-technical stakeholders can act on

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Databricks AI/BI, Genie, or Vector Search
  • Experience supporting ML or LLM-based downstream use cases
  • Background in data mesh or domain-oriented data architecture

Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

description:
Natural Resource Conservation Scientist (AI Training)

About The Role

Your expertise in natural resource conservation doesn't just belong in the field — it belongs at the frontier of AI development. We're looking for experienced conservation and environmental scientists to help evaluate and improve AI systems trained on environmental science, land management, and conservation decision-making.

Your scientific knowledge will directly shape how AI understands and communicates complex conservation topics — helping ensure these systems are accurate, responsible, and grounded in real-world practice.

  • Organization: Alignerr (Powered by Labelbox)
  • Type: Hourly / Task-Based Contract
  • Location: Fully Remote
  • Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

What You'll Do

  • Review conservation science questions and real-world scenarios used in AI training datasets
  • Evaluate the scientific accuracy of AI-generated content covering land use, ecosystems, soil science, hydrology, and biodiversity
  • Assess whether AI-generated recommendations reflect current, real-world conservation practices and standards
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve AI scientific reasoning and output quality
  • Work independently and asynchronously on a schedule that fits your life

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of professional experience in natural resource conservation, land management, or environmental science
  • Strong working knowledge of ecosystems, conservation principles, and applied land management
  • Able to critically evaluate scientific reasoning and identify flaws or gaps in AI-generated recommendations
  • Comfortable reviewing structured written content and delivering detailed, actionable feedback
  • Self-motivated and reliable when working independently on remote, task-based projects

Nice to Have

  • Master's degree or PhD in Natural Resources, Environmental Science, Ecology, or a related field
  • Hands-on fieldwork or applied conservation project experience
  • Familiarity with AI systems, content evaluation workflows, or data annotation platforms

Why Join Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI — contribute to the development of advanced large language models (LLMs) alongside top research organizations
  • Fully remote and flexible — work on your own schedule, from anywhere
  • Make a real impact — your expertise helps ensure AI gets environmental science right
  • Freelance perks — autonomy, variety, and collaboration with a global community of experts
  • Potential for ongoing work — strong contributors are considered for contract extensions and future projects

title: Senior Security Engineer (GRC)
description:
About us

Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page:

About the team

The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership.

The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit.

About the role

You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders.

You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products.

Key responsibilities

  • Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy.
  • Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI‑DSS).
  • Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk‑based and scalable way.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies.
  • Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards.
  • Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues.
  • Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks.
  • Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems.
  • Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward‑looking, data‑driven insights to senior management and Committees.
  • Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally.

Qualification Requirements

  • Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI‑DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar.
  • Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees.
  • Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields.
  • Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases.
  • Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts.
  • Advanced English (written and verbal) required.

Nice to have Requirements

  • Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus.

International experience is highly desirable.

Benefits

  • Proven experience working with databases, both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and non‑relational (e.g., Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB), including data modelling, query optimisation, and performance tuning

  • Comfortable with networking protocols and distributed communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, WebSockets, TCP/UDP)

description:
Principal Software Engineer - Credit Card Core Platforms

Sr Staff Software Engineer - CC Core Platforms

About Nubank Nu is the world’s largest digital banking platform outside of Asia, serving over 123 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The company has been leading an industry transformation by leveraging data and proprietary technology to develop innovative products and services. Guided by its mission to fight complexity and empower people, Nu caters to customers’ complete financial journey, promoting financial access and advancement with responsible lending and transparency. The company is powered by an efficient and scalable business model that combines low cost to serve with growing returns. Nu’s impact has been recognized in multiple awards, including Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Banks. The Company is preparing for its next growth cycle where it will accelerate its internationalization process outside Latin America, and will also enter new verticals beyond financial services in its core markets taking advantage of the significant customer penetration.

About the role We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical evolution of our Credit Card platform. This is not a traditional maintenance role. You will be the architect of a profound transformation: leveraging Generative AI to automate complex operational tasks and orchestrating the global migration from our current systems to a unified, future-proof architecture. You will be a key partner to the Engineering Leadership and a reference for the entire engineering community.

Mission Your goal is to design and operationalize a technical strategy that uses AI to increase operational efficiency while accelerating our global migration, ensuring:

  • Intelligent Maintenance: Implementing AI agents to analyze tickets and crashes, automating resolutions for the global credit card environment.
  • Seamless Migration: Leading the coexistence strategy between legacy and new platforms across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, ensuring data integrity and a flawless customer experience.
  • Technical Excellence: Solving deep architectural bottlenecks in high-scale distributed systems and raising the bar for software design globally.

Core Responsibilities

  • Migration Strategy: Define the long-term roadmap for decommissioning legacy systems, starting with the 1-year migration plan for the Colombian market.
  • AI-Driven Engineering: Architect and integrate AI solutions (cloud-based agents) to automate infrastructure maintenance and data migration.
  • Strategic Partnership: Collaborate with General Managers, PMs, and Staff+ ICs to align technical decisions with business needs across different countries.
  • Mentorship & Culture: Mentor senior engineers, fostering a culture of pragmatism, excellence in distributed systems, and the adoption of cutting-edge AI tools.
  • Navigating Complexity: You will work on high-scale systems supporting millions of transactions where every decision impacts customer limits and billing.
  • Modernizing the Core: You have the unique opportunity to make "legacy" systems attractive and efficient by applying AI to remove heavy operational toil.

Core Qualifications (What We’re Looking For)

  • Proven Track Record: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on large-scale distributed systems.
  • Migration Mastery: Proven experience leading critical system migrations and managing coexistence between old and new architectures.
  • AI Fluency: A strong interest or practical experience in using GenAI/LLMs to solve engineering productivity and data analysis challenges.
  • Platform Mindset: Ability to design reusable APIs and contracts that serve multiple product teams with high reliability.
  • Global Communication: Fluent English is required to collaborate across our global hubs (Brazil, US, Mexico, and Colombia).

Context & Environment

A posição atua no mercado brasileiro, caracterizado por um ambiente jurídico e regulatório complexo e em constante evolução. O cargo exige interação e colaboração frequentes com uma ampla gama de partes internas e externas, incluindo clientes internos, escritórios de advocacia, associações do setor, parceiros de joint ventures, fornecedores e autoridades governamentais.

Dada a natureza dessas interações, a função demanda fortes habilidades de negociação e a capacidade de se engajar de forma estratégica e eficaz com diferentes públicos.

Atividades

Principais Atividades

A posição de Especialista Jurídico Sênior é responsável por executar as seguintes atividades, com certo nível de autonomia, em alinhamento com as orientações do Gerente Jurídico e do Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa:

  1. Assessoria Jurídica Estratégica: Prestar assessoria jurídica e regulatória estratégica aos clientes internos, como equipes de Joint Ventures (JVs), em matérias administrativas, societárias, ambientais, cíveis, regulatórias de E&P e contenciosas.
  2. Elaboração e Negociação Contratual: Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos comerciais, societários e operacionais relevantes, assegurando alinhamento com os modelos da TTE (quando aplicável), com os requisitos legais e com os objetivos do negócio.
  3. Suporte à Governança de JVs: Apoiar as joint ventures em processos de governança, identificando riscos jurídicos, propondo medidas de mitigação e garantindo a conformidade ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.
  4. Relacionamento com Stakeholders e Autoridades: Atuar junto a partes externas, como autoridades governamentais, parceiros de joint ventures e associações do setor, apoiando o posicionamento jurídico da companhia e protegendo seus direitos e obrigações.
  5. Resolução de Conflitos: Recomendar e implementar estratégias e conduzir processos de resolução de disputas, incluindo arbitragens de alto valor, processos administrativos e judiciais, assegurando estratégia coerente, adequada avaliação de riscos e coordenação eficaz com escritórios externos.
  6. Monitoramento Legal e Regulatório e Avaliação de Impactos no Negócio: Monitorar evoluções legais e regulatórias que impactem as atividades de E&P e assessorar o negócio quanto a impactos, riscos e medidas de implementação necessárias.
  7. Coordenação de Escritórios Externos: Coordenar as atividades com escritórios de advocacia externos e especialistas, garantindo consistência estratégica e alto padrão de entregáveis.
  8. Representação e Atuação Institucional: Representar a companhia em comitês externos (ex.: IBP) e organizações do setor, liderando iniciativas de advocacy em matérias jurídicas e regulatórias e protegendo os ativos, a reputação e a licença social para operar no longo prazo.
  9. Reporte à Gestão: Reportar de forma consistente e buscar orientação da gestão em assuntos que envolvam elevada exposição financeira ou impacto reputacional.
  10. One Maestro: Atuar em conformidade com os princípios de HSSSE e One Maestro, visando proteger os ativos, a reputação e a licença de longo prazo para operar da companhia.

Responsabilidades

O Especialista Jurídico Sênior prestará suporte a outras divisões da TEPBR, conforme alocação definida pelo Gerente Jurídico e pelo Diretor de Jurídico, Assuntos Regulatórios e Governança Corporativa, bem como elaborará análises sobre temas regulatórios e jurídicos de média-alta complexidade e materialidade, relacionados a atividades, ativos e projetos especiais.

O cargo também apoiará a implementação e a observância das regras e regulamentos de Compliance e de HSE aplicáveis. O(a) empregado(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro, com foco na proteção da integridade das pessoas, preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, contribuindo para a eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia.

Perfil do Candidato

Nível de qualificação: Bacharelado em Direito, com registro ativo na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil (OAB).

Competências técnicas:

Experiência jurídica em nível sênior, com sólido conhecimento do arcabouço regulatório brasileiro e da prática internacional, especialmente em Leis do Petróleo e regulamentações da ANP. Experiência em estruturas contratuais sofisticadas de E&P é um diferencial, incluindo estruturas complexas de governança em múltiplos regimes jurídicos (PSC, Concessão), unitizações, redeterminações, bem como contratos de serviços técnicos (EPCIs e outros).

Competências comportamentais:

  • Comunicação: excelente comunicação verbal e habilidade de redação.
  • Influência e negociação: fortes habilidades de negociação e capacidade de influenciar diferentes stakeholders.
  • Autonomia e alinhamento: capacidade de atuar com bom nível de autonomia, mantendo alinhamento com a direção da gestão.
  • Priorização e entrega: habilidade para gerenciar alto volume de trabalho, priorizar de forma eficaz e entregar sob pressão de prazos.
  • Mentalidade de negócio: aplicação pragmática do conhecimento jurídico para viabilizar os objetivos do negócio em ambiente jurídico desafiador.
  • Gestão de riscos e resolução de problemas: abordagem estruturada e estratégica para solução de problemas; definição e implementação de estratégias de mitigação de riscos.
  • Adaptabilidade: atualização constante frente à evolução das leis e regulamentos; desenvolvimento de soluções jurídicas e contratuais inovadoras para atender às necessidades da afiliada.
  • Colaboração e resiliência: postura colaborativa, resiliência, persistência e estilo pragmático/criativo de assessoria jurídica.
  • Ética: elevados padrões éticos.

Experiência profissional: mínimo de 10 anos de experiência jurídica, majoritariamente na indústria de Óleo e Gás (Upstream).

title: Transportation Specialist, ROC
description:
ROC (Relay Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA, EU, India, Mexico, Brazil etc. It ensures hassle free, timely pick‑up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with tactical problem solving ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Overview of a Transportation Specialist

A Transportation Specialist at ROC facilitates the flow of information between different stakeholders (Trans Carriers/Hubs/Warehouses) and resolves any potential issues that impact customer experience and business continuity. The role works across two verticals – Inbound and Outbound operations. Inbound Operations deals with Vendor/Carrier/FC relationships, ensuring that freight is picked‑up on time and delivered to FC as per the given appointment. Outbound Operations deals with FC/Carrier/Carrier Hub relationships, ensuring that the truck leaves the FC to deliver customer orders as per promise. A Transportation Specialist provides timely resolution by researching and querying internal tools, taking real‑time decisions, analyzing data, noticing trends, and driving customer experience without compromising on time. The ideal candidate should understand basic logistics, communicate clearly in written and oral form, ideate process improvements, and drive them to completion.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)
  • Provide real‑time customer experience in a 24/7 operating environment
  • Systematically escalate problems or variances in information and data to relevant owners and teams, and follow through on resolutions
  • Develop and/or understand performance metrics to assist with driving business results
  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, to create narratives outlining weekly findings, variances to goals, and present these findings in a review forum
  • Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs, measuring and identifying activities performed
  • Quickly understand the business impact of trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data

title: Research Assistant
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Basic Function

Howard University is currently seeking a highly motivated and organized Research Assistant to work on a federally funded research study related to COVID-19. The Research Assistants will be primarily responsible for recruiting potential adult participants at Howard University Hospital in Washington DC and the neighboring communities. Participants to be enrolled for the study are past COVID-19 patients. The study seeks to assess Long COVID prevalence and associated risk factors.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Screen electronic medical records to identify eligible study participants, contact potential participants in a timely manner.
  • Obtain informed consent in accordance with research protocols, procedures, and good clinical practice guidelines.
  • Administer survey assessments and enter data in REDCap.
  • Perform and document risk assessments.
  • Attend mandatory study specific trainings and team meetings.
  • Complete and file daily paperwork accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Organize and maintain study participants’ data and extract medical data as needed.
  • Document accurate encounters and shift events, adhere to all study procedures, and communicate daily/weekly updates to study coordinator and recruitment lead.
  • Assist the follow-up team in preparing participants’ scheduling and completing follow-up visits virtually and in person.
  • Other duties deemed necessary to maintain smooth operations of the research program such as biospecimen preparation, packaging and mailing to the biorepository core.

Core Competencies

As a critical component to the success of the study, the primary responsibility of the Research Assistants will be patients’ engagement, community outreach, and participants’ enrollment in the study. Personable, detail-oriented, flexible with scheduling, able to work independently and as part of a team.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Sciences, Public Health or health-related fields.

Previous research experience, clinic/hospital work or volunteer experience, and knowledge of the research process is preferred. This position requires flexibility and availability to adapt to patients’ schedules. Reliable transportation is necessary to complete participants’ interviews at various community locations. Spanish language is a plus.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$40,000-$50,000

title: Recepcionista de clínica médica
description:
A Clínica Neurovida é uma clínica médica de excelência, pioneira no atendimento acessível e de qualidade no estado do Rio de Janeiro. Em suas três unidades (Recreio dos Bandeirantes, São João de Meriti e Freguesia) os pacientes podem realizar exames essenciais, de rotina e preventivos, com agilidade, segurança e utilizando equipamentos de ponta a preços que cabem no bolso.

Atividades

  • Dar início ao atendimento dos pacientes, lançando a senha no monitor.
  • Realizar o cadastro completo do paciente antes da consulta
  • Atuar sempre orientado para o paciente, de forma rápida e eficiente, visando sua plena satisfação com o atendimento proporcionado;
  • Realizar os procedimentos iniciais, abrindo a Unidade, verificar se o totem das senhas está carregado com o rolo de senha de papel, checando se o espaço está totalmente organizado para abertura da Clínica;
  • Sanar dúvidas eventuais do paciente sobre especialidades da clínica, nome e agenda dos médicos, planos, redes, procedimentos e exames que são realizados e valores, para o seu pleno entendimento
  • Pedir ao paciente a identidade e carteirinha do seu plano, para realizar a elegibilidade do mesmo no site da operadora
  • Conferir atentamente as informações quanto a Plano, Rede, Especialidade, Senha, Token e Médico estão corretas;
  • Informar ao paciente que não tenha plano de saúde o valor correto da consulta ou exame, e ficar atento a forma de pagamento.
  • Atender solicitação de marcação de consulta, verificando no sistema SISCCON a agenda médica, informando ao paciente as datas e horários disponíveis na especialidade e/ou médico informado, para realizar no sistema a marcação conforme sua escolha.
  • Preencher e entregar ao paciente o ticket com o agendamento;
  • Imprimir a guia de consulta e colher a assinatura do paciente, para confirmar a sua autorização ao plano de saúde
  • Ter plena atenção as guias, onde o médico pode incluir procedimentos durante a consulta (oftalmo/dermatologia/otorrino/alergista/ginecologia), e que são impressas ao final das consultas,
  • Conferir a quantidade de guias com os atendimentos, e verificar se as mesmas estão preenchidas corretamente.
  • Oferecer ao paciente a marcação da consulta de retorno ou marcação de exames
  • Receber do CallCenter, via whatsapp, referente a exames e procedimentos, o pedido médico e a carteirinha do plano, para iniciar o processo de autorização prévia do exame ou procedimento;
  • Conferir na véspera de realização dos exames as senhas de autorização pelo plano de saúde.
  • Atender solicitações do paciente para impressão dos resultados dos seus exames
  • Atender eventuais solicitações dos médicos quanto a falta de folha A4 na impressora, assim como para a reposição de materiais de escritório ou higiene, como caneta, sabão e toalhas de papel
  • Informar ao final do expediente a quantidade de pacientes faltosos e atendidos no dia, e seus respectivos médicos, para dar ciência a todos e a diretoria;
  • Receber dos entregadores externos os materiais da enfermagem, de escritório e outros, comprados pela empresa, conferindo atentamente se os itens e quantitativos entregues
  • Informar ao coordenador qualquer problema verificado nos equipamentos, móveis, utensílios e instalações em geral, para que o ambiente de trabalho esteja sempre adequado às necessidades do dia a dia;
  • Estar atento e comunicar ao coordenador qualquer erro no sistema, processos da recepção ou qualquer outra condição observada como inadequada ou errada, para as devidas providências;

Requisitos

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência em recepção de clínica médica ou hospitalar
  • Experiência em informática e facilidade com plataformas de planos de saúde
  • Conhecimento em planilhas e agendas eletrônicas

Our client is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform built for social media managers, agencies, and brands. We are looking for a sharp, disciplined Account Executive who closes deals without losing the relationship along the way. You are not just good on a call. You are the person who sends the follow-up within the hour, keeps prospects warm through a 30-day cycle, and never lets a qualified lead go cold because of a dropped ball on your end.

Additional Requirements

  • 3+ years of closing experience in a B2B SaaS AE role

  • Exceptional discovery skills. You know how to ask questions that surface real buying motivation and you do not move to demo until you have earned it
  • Organized to a fault. You have a system for follow-up and you never miss a touchpoint because something slipped through the cracks
  • Strong written communication. Your follow-up emails are short, clear, and move the deal forward. Not essays, not templates that feel like templates
  • Fluency in HubSpot or comparable CRM. Pipeline hygiene is not something you need to be reminded about

title: Quais Empresas De Ônibus No RJ Estão Contratando Motorista
description:
✅ Empresas de ônibus como Viação Redentor, Real Auto Ônibus e Transportes Flores estão contratando motoristas no RJ.

Atualmente, várias empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro estão com processos seletivos abertos para a contratação de motoristas. Essas oportunidades são frequentes devido à alta demanda por profissionais capacitados para atuar no transporte público, sobretudo em grandes centros urbanos como o RJ. Entre as empresas que estão contratando, destacam-se companhias que operam linhas municipais, intermunicipais e interestaduais, oferecendo vagas que normalmente exigem CNH categoria D ou E, além de experiência comprovada.

Este artigo detalha quais são as principais empresas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro que estão contratando motoristas atualmente, explicando os requisitos básicos para se candidatar, as formas de inscrição e os benefícios que essas empresas costumam oferecer. Além disso, abordamos dicas importantes para quem deseja ingressar nessa área, incluindo informações sobre o mercado de trabalho, a demanda por motoristas e os cuidados para escolher a vaga ideal.

Empresas de ônibus no RJ com vagas abertas para motoristas

  • Viação 1001 – Atua nas linhas interestaduais e intermunicipais, frequentemente buscando motoristas com experiência e CNH categoria D ou E.
  • Viação São Silvestre – Opera linhas municipais em vários bairros do RJ e costuma abrir vagas para motoristas, principalmente em períodos de alta demanda.
  • Auto Viação Jabour – Empresa tradicional no transporte público urbano do RJ, que em algumas épocas contrata profissionais para reforço em suas operações.
  • Viação Novo Rio – Especializada em linhas urbanas e rodoviárias, frequentemente disponibiliza vagas para motoristas qualificados.
  • Viação Redentor – Conhecida pelo transporte intermunicipal, mantém processos seletivos regulares para motoristas profissionais.

Requisitos legais e habilitação

Antes de mais nada, o candidato precisa possuir Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) na categoria D ou E , que permite a condução de veículos com mais de 8 passageiros . Além disso, a Certificação de Curso MOPP (Movimentação Operacional de Produtos Perigosos) pode ser exigida por algumas empresas, especialmente para linhas que eventualmente transportem cargas específicas.

  • CNH categoria D ou E válida e regularizada;
  • Comprovante de residência atualizado;
  • Certificado do curso MOPP (quando aplicável);
  • Atestado de saúde ocupacional para garantir aptidão física e mental;
  • Currículo atualizado com experiência comprovada na função.

Requisitos comuns para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • CNH categoria D ou E: obrigatória para condução de veículos de transporte coletivo.
  • Experiência comprovada: muitas empresas exigem no mínimo 1 a 2 anos de experiência como motorista de ônibus.
  • Curso de Transporte Coletivo: certificado pelo DETRAN, necessário para alguns processos seletivos.
  • Exame médico e psicológico: para garantir a aptidão física e mental do candidato.
  • Disponibilidade de horário: Muitas vagas exigem trabalho em turnos, finais de semana e feriados.

Competências Comportamentais e Técnicas

  • Responsabilidade e atenção redobrada ao trafegar em vias urbanas e rodoviárias sob condições variadas;
  • Boa comunicação para lidar com passageiros e equipe;
  • Conhecimento das rotas e pontos turísticos do RJ;
  • Capacidade de resolução rápida de problemas e situações de emergência;
  • Resistência física para longas jornadas de trabalho.

Benefícios comuns oferecidos para motoristas de ônibus no RJ

  • Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e planos de carreira são comuns nas empresas do setor.

Média salarial para motoristas de ônibus no Rio de Janeiro

A média varia entre R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000, dependendo da empresa, turno e benefícios oferecidos.

Pontos-chave sobre Contratação de Motoristas de Ônibus no RJ

  • Empresas principais: Viação 1001, Viação Penha, Auto Viação Redentor, Viação Sul Fluminense.
  • Requisitos: CNH D, experiência anterior, curso especializado em transporte coletivo.
  • Salário médio: R$ 1.800 a R$ 3.000 mensais, com benefícios inclusos.
  • Onde buscar vagas: Sites oficiais, plataformas de emprego (InfoJobs, Indeed, LinkedIn).
  • Processo seletivo: Pode incluir testes práticos, entrevistas e análise de documentação.
  • Benefícios comuns: Vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica, seguro de vida.
  • Mercado: Alta demanda por motoristas qualificados devido ao transporte coletivo urbano no RJ.

General Requirements

  • Promotes a Safe and Respectful Work Environment: Proactively promotes and maintains a healthy respect for open and transparent dialogue between all levels of personnel.
  • Demonstrates care for the safety and well‑being of all personnel, at all times.
  • Invests in each person to provide equal opportunity for development and advancement of those qualified, to fulfill their career objectives.

  • Complete company training requirements for the MPD Equipment Specialist job level as per the training matrix, including in local/regulatory requirements.
  • If applicable, the duties and responsibilities in the safety case for this position must be observed.
  • Full participation in emergency drills and respond to emergency situations as per assigned duties on the station bill.

Operational Discipline Requirements

  • Disciplined application and participation in the Task Planning & Risk Assessment Process.
  • Understanding and perform the roles and responsibilities as assigned at the pre‑job meeting.
  • Understanding the hazards associated with the task.
  • Understanding and effectively implementing the control measures required to mitigate identified hazards.
  • Execute all tasks and task steps in a disciplined manner, following the sequence detailed in the relevant procedures.
  • Recognize at‑risk behavior or conditions during tasks and call ‘Time out for Safety’ when unsure, or when the job does not go as planned.
  • Participate in After Action Reviews to feedback lessons learned from performing the task.

HSE Requirements

  • Report all incidents, potential hazards or abnormal situations to supervisors.
  • Actively execute work in accordance with Company Safety Processes, e.g. START, Task Planning Risk Assessment and use of the Prompt Card, Safe Manual Handling, Working at Heights, etc.
  • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) when you do not understand the plan, when an unsafe condition is observed, or perceived, anytime personal impairment is recognized, when it’s not clear what will happen next, or the hazards and associated risks for the task changes.
  • Participate in the execution of the rigs ‘Hold the Zero’ plan.
  • Comply with the company requirements to safeguard ‘lone workers.’
  • Maintain a safe and organized work area throughout all tasks and on completion of tasks.
  • Incorporate the Task Planning and Risk Assessment process into all tasks, whether working alone or as part of a team.
  • Apply the START process during the execution of planned tasks and daily operations.
  • Ensure subordinate personnel are properly trained in the START process.
  • Ensure subordinates are trained prior to using the permit to work (PTW) process.
  • Approve all PTW as designated by the Master/OIM through the Control of Work Process; ensure all task steps and controls are understood and any other activities that may be affected are identified before approving the PTW.
  • Call a Time Out for Safety (TOFS) whenever an unplanned hazard or a change in the expected results is observed.
  • Ensure that the Company QHSE policies and other programs are communicated to and understood by all personnel.
  • Play an active part in the weekly meetings, FOCUS Improvement Program, and all other Company safety management systems.
  • Ensure that a high standard of hygiene and housekeeping is maintained within the Areas of Responsibility.
  • Ensure that subordinates understand their roles as related to the Emergency Response Plan and are capable of responding to emergency situations as designated on the station bill.
  • Ensure all required well control drills are performed and evaluate all personnel’s responses; Conduct After Action Reviews and ensure that findings are communicated to the crew and lessons learned captured.
  • Ensure that DROPS inspections are conducted as per the rig’s DROPS inspection program.

Duties

  • The underlying expectation is that all duties are carried out in compliance with the Company Operational Discipline expectations and HSE requirements.

Operations/Maintenance – General Duties

  • Perform maintenance and repair of all MPD equipment inclusive of surface manifolds, RCD and MPD IRJ components and associated surface equipment such as the HPU, HCS, reels and accessories.
  • Lead the onsite operation of the MPD IRJ and associated components ensuring compliance with the relevant policies and procedures.
  • Train and mentor subsea department on all MPD IRJ related tasks.
  • A good understanding of all regulatory documentation such as API 16RCD, API 92S etc.
  • Supervise all MPD equipment inspection requirements and advise relevant members of any deficiencies.
  • Identify any potential equipment or operational issues and report using the correct processes.
  • Complete sealing element evaluation reports and any other required field documentation and upload to AIM. Ensure MPD manager is copied in distribution.
  • Lead all IRJ rig up and operational procedures.
  • Complete AAR of every MPD IRJ deployment and retrieval. Submit to MPD manager.
  • Record all equipment associated downtime in AIM and ensure MPD manager is copied.
  • Advise on correct sealing element sizing and properties for each bearing assembly deployment.
  • Troubleshoot all MPD equipment and implement corrective action.
  • Ensure all equipment is current and complete to latest revision levels including operation manuals.
  • Competent in the use of the MPD control software.
  • Perform various other duties and activities as assigned by supervisor within the physical constraints of the job.
  • Liaise with equipment OEMs to ensure latest policies and procedures are adhered to.

description:
Sobre a Volpi

Somos uma fintech em crescimento acelerado que está protagonizando a evolução do financiamento imobiliário . Transformamos processos tradicionalmente burocráticos, caros e ineficientes em experiências inteligentes, simples e digitais . Se você acredita que tecnologia pode mudar a vida das pessoas - e quer fazer parte de uma equipe que vive isso na prática - vem com a gente!

O desafio

Buscamos um Senior Data Engineer para liderar a construção da engenharia de dados da Volpi desde a base.

Hoje, nossos dados estão distribuídos em múltiplas fontes, com diferentes níveis de maturidade. Seu papel será estruturar essa fundação: definir a arquitetura, organizar os dados, criar pipelines confiáveis e habilitar a criação de produtos de dados que apoiem decisões críticas de negócio.

Aqui, você terá alto nível de autonomia e ownership , tomando decisões técnicas que vão sustentar o crescimento da empresa nos próximos anos.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Desenhar, implementar e evoluir a arquitetura de dados da Volpi , com foco em um modelo de lakehouse na AWS;
  • Estruturar pipelines de ingestão, transformação e consumo de dados (batch e, futuramente, streaming);
  • Trabalhar com dados sensíveis de crédito e pessoas, seguindo padrões rigorosos de segurança, governança e compliance ;
  • Lidar com dados distribuídos em múltiplos silos , conectando fontes e criando visões mais maduras para o negócio;
  • Atender demandas estratégicas de diferentes áreas (crédito, operações, produto, engenharia);
  • Organizar e evoluir o data lake existente (já temos estrutura inicial em AWS, Athena e S3);
  • Criar a base para produtos de dados futuros , incluindo análises avançadas de crédito e soluções orientadas a dados;
  • Atuar de forma full-cycle, da concepção técnica à implementação, operação e evolução em produção.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência sólida como Data Engineer , com forte mentalidade de engenharia (Data Engineer aqui é dev);
  • Domínio de Python e SQL para construção de pipelines e soluções de dados em produção;
  • Experiência prática com AWS , especialmente serviços como S3, Athena e IAM;
  • Conhecimento e uso de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC) ;
  • Vivência com pipelines de dados em produção, lidando com volumes relevantes e dados sensíveis;
  • Forte preocupação com segurança da informação , padrões de projeto e boas práticas de engenharia;
  • Experiência em ambientes de startup , lidando com pouco legado e muita construção do zero;
  • Autonomia para tomar decisões técnicas e conduzir projetos end-to-end;
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados escaláveis;
  • Comunicação clara e estruturada, especialmente em ambientes assíncronos.

Será considerado um diferencial:

  • Experiência com arquiteturas de dados modernas, como lakehouse;
  • Uso de ferramentas de orquestração e transformação de dados (ex: Airflow, dbt ou similares);
  • Atuação em domínios complexos e regulados, como financeiro, crédito ou seguros;
  • Vivência na construção e estruturação de plataformas ou áreas de dados desde o início.

Benefícios que oferecemos:

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.

Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA
  • Formação: Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório).

  • Curso de Supervisão de Segurança (desejável).

  • Habilitação: CNH Categoria A/B (obrigatória – o supervisor pode atuar com moto ou carro).
  • Experiência comprovada como vigilante.
  • Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência como líder de equipe, inspetor ou supervisor de segurança.
  • Vivência com rondas operacionais e atendimento ao cliente será considerado um diferencial.
  • Roteirização e controle de visitas a postos.
  • Técnicas de supervisão, liderança e abordagem de equipe.
  • Noções de vigilância patrimonial e segurança eletrônica.
  • Uso de aplicativos para controle de ponto, checklists e elaboração de relatórios.

title: Senior Product Manager - Mode (Remote)
description:
About Mode Mobile

Mode Mobile is the creator of EarnOS, a transformational software that turns ordinary smartphones into "EarnPhones". This innovation empowers users globally to monetize everyday mobile activities such as streaming, gaming, shopping, etc., turning users into earners and, eventually, owners through stock ownership based on usage. The company has facilitated over $150M in earnings and savings for more than 40 million users across 170 countries.

Team & Culture

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, curiosity, and a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster open communication and transparency. Our culture is driven by OKRs, positive intent, ownership, and a commitment to high standards.

For more details on how we work, you can read further at our internal resources.

The Role

Mode Mobile is seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead product strategy and execution for a recently acquired multimillion‑dollar utility app. Over time, the role will expand to encompass newly acquired and organically developed mobile applications. This senior‑level, high‑ownership role requires a proven product leader with business acumen, operational excellence, and user empathy.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define and lead a vision for your products that aligns with organizational goals
  • Develop strategic product‑feature roadmaps and drive execution from concept to scale by analyzing and implementing best‑in‑market trends and out‑of‑the‑box ideas
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Design, User Acquisition, Monetization, and Data teams to deliver value‑driven, measurable results
  • Own business and product performance, including revenue, engagement, conversion, retention, and P&L outcomes, and financial forecasts
  • Conduct ongoing experimentation, user and competitor research to support strategic decision making that drives monetization and user growth
  • Provide visibility into business performance and communicate results clearly to executive stakeholders and the broader organization
  • Serve as a role model and standard‑setter for product excellence for your cross‑function team
Who You Are
  • A strategic, business‑minded product leader with deep understanding of P&L ownership and revenue drivers
  • A self‑starter who thrives in ambiguity and operates with high accountability in driving efficient product pipelines
  • Experienced leading product dev teams to drive engagement and impact on the product and business
  • Expert at balancing user value with business impact, ensuring that both scale together
  • Skilled at using data, A/B experimentation, and intuition to make the best possible decisions
  • A natural collaborator who communicates effectively across all levels of the organization
  • Alignment with our core values
  • Accountable: Take ownership of responsibilities, demonstrate trustworthiness, and consistently follow through on commitments
  • Action‑driven: Identify priorities, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact
  • Caring: Genuinely care about people, the business, and the mission, and strive to create a positive, supportive environment
  • Curious: Focus on the "why," learn, expand knowledge, explore new ideas, and continually improve
  • Thorough: Deliver thoughtful, accurate, and complete work with meticulous attention to detail
Qualifications
  • 7+ years of professional product management experience, including 3+ years of independently owning a product or business line
  • Proven experience managing products with P&L accountability and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Experience in mobile app ecosystems, with strong understanding of subscription, IAP, and IAA monetization strategies (utility, rewarded, social, or gaming apps is a plus)
  • Demonstrated success within multi‑app portfolios
  • Strong analytical skills; proficiency in data tools such as Mixpanel, Google Sheets, and business performance dashboards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, capable of influencing at the executive level
Why This Role Matters

This is a high‑impact role where you will be the ringleader for one of Mode's most successful mobile apps, driving millions of users and ~$10 M / yr in revenue. Your success can help create blueprints for aggressive expansion through in‑house products and M&A, opening opportunities across the portfolio.

Workplace Norms
  • Allow OKRs to guide us
  • Assume positive intent
  • Agree to disagree & commit
  • Set new precedents
  • Accomplish more with less
  • Hold yourself & others to high standards
  • Speak up
  • Be resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 rule
What We Are Offering
  • 100% remote‑first, global company
  • A competitive compensation package
  • Generous perks & benefits
  • Participation in the company equity and token plan (full‑time)
  • Individual bonuses in accordance with our bonus program
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people
  • Celebrate personal & work milestones
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies
  • Recognition via Bonusly
  • Weekly Wednesday "Get Stuff Done Days" (no meetings)
  • Open PTO and generous company holidays
  • 10 annual Wellness Fridays
Next Steps

If we just described the role you want and your ideal team, we'd love to talk with you. We have a lot to accomplish this year and look forward to creating success together!

Equal Employment Opportunity

Mode Mobile does not accept or pay fees for unsolicited resumes from third‑party agencies/vendors. Our company is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We celebrate diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all team members.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.

You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.

Additional Information

About Us

We Are Engineered Different.

At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e gerenciar políticas e procedimentos de segurança específicos para operações onshore e offshore, alinhados com as regulamentações e padrões da empresa.

  • Experiência em funções relacionadas à saúde e segurança ocupacional, preferencialmente em ambientes industriais ou de grande porte.
  • Conhecimento sólido das normas regulamentadoras (NRs), técnicas de investigação de incidentes e outras legislações aplicáveis à saúde e segurança no trabalho.
  • Necessária experiência com O&G e regulamentos técnicos da ANP (SGSO, SGIP, SGSS, etc.).
  • Habilidades analíticas e capacidade de conduzir investigações de acidentes e análises de riscos.

title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Senior Legal Counsel Main responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English ; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors .
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions , especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties , state‑owned entities , or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance .
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What success looks like in this role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

description:
We are seeking experienced marine seismic processing and depth imaging specialists (with 5 plus years of industry experience) to join our growing and energetic project teams in delivering high-quality seismic services to the oil and gas industry. There is an opportunity for long‑term career progression and increasing responsibility as technical and project management skills development.

The successful candidate must be highly motivated to work in a fast‑moving and high‑tech work environment, have the capacity to work independently with careful attention to detail, and demonstrate initiative and problem‑solving skills. He or she should have several years of practical experience in seismic processing ideally with depth imaging knowledge too. Be self‑sufficient and proficient in implementing all imaging tasks and workflows with a comprehensive understanding of all technologies deployed. Experience of OBC or OBN would be beneficial. Skilled in dealing and working with clients, able to QA / QC less experienced members of the team.

To deliver the highest quality products to both internal stakeholders and external clients, with minimal supervisory management.

Together with Team Manager, experienced Geophysicists are expected to take on a technical leadership role within their project teams.

List of Responsibilities
  • Managing, preparing, and ensuring quality control of, geosciences data to support seismic processing and depth imaging projects.
  • Seismic time processing and depth imaging of 2D and 3D, seismic data (from field data to final product) including design of processing flows; selection and testing of processing parameters; velocity interpretation and model building.
  • Preparing, running and managing production workflows on the company computer system and resolving any issues that may arise during a production run.
  • QA / QC of technical workflows, processing results, new/updated software and processing tools, client presentations, project documentation for team projects, and technical and QA/QC procedures.
  • Managing the implementation and timelines of assigned projects; preparing project reports and presentations, and participating in project meetings (where appropriate), for both internal and external clients.
  • Assisting with the management of client relationships for team projects, holding and running meetings.
  • Helping to supervise and manage the work of junior and technical support staff.
  • Performing other related tasks as assigned by the Team Leader.
Requirements
  • BSc, MSc or Ph.D. in Geophysics / Physics / Maths / Electrical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical work experience in a marine seismic processing/depth imaging team.
  • Experience of OBC or OBN would be beneficial.
  • Knowledge of, and experience working with, Linux and/or Unix, and industry processing/depth imaging tools; basic scripting and/or programming skills.
  • Excellent communication skills; fluent in English.
  • Organised and able to produce accurate work.
  • Motivated to complete assigned responsibilities within set deadlines.

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
